About us

We're Danny Klein and Matt Campfield, together Some Randoms, a Los Angeles production duo with an ear for genre-crossing hits. Since moving out from Virginia we've built a reputation as a versatile team across R&B, hip-hop, pop and musical theater.

Our first executive-producer credit came on Emmy Meli's debut LP Hello Stranger, released through BMG. Lately we've also been writing songs for Xtravaganza, a new musical premiering in May 2027.
